files.quality_label: Noether Papers 18-20 official GDZ source/page-map backfill
files.coverage: P18: GDZ JDMV 30 (1921) printed p.101, selecting the Noether/Hentzelt canvas from two duplicated printed-p101 candidates. P19: GDZ Mathematische Annalen 83 (1921) LOG_0008, `Idealtheorie in Ringbereichen`, printed pp.24-66. P20: GDZ Mathematische Annalen 85 (1922) LOG_0010, `Ein algebraisches Kriterium fuer absolute Irreduzibilitaet`, printed pp.26-33.
files.contents: GDZ/IIIF manifests, printed-page/canvas maps, raw full-resolution GDZ page images, article PDFs, image-dimension CSVs, file inventory, source-quality/use-limit CSV, README, and checksums.
files.findings: The package corrects an earlier P20 source-intake trap: exploratory Math. Ann. 85 LOG_0004-LOG_0008 downloads were false candidates, with LOG_0008 belonging to Kummer/Fermat rather than Noether. It identifies P20 as LOG_0010, canvases 00000036-00000043 / printed pp.26-33. For P18, it excludes the wrong duplicated printed-p101 canvas and retains canvas 00000301 as the visible start of the Noether/Hentzelt item.
files.limitations: Source/provenance and page-map material only. P18 is 600 ppi, below the project 650 dpi checking floor. P19/P20 are official full GDZ raw images but about 400 ppi, below 650/1000 dpi dense-certification thresholds. This package contains no corrected TeX, no translation, no full Paper 18/19/20 certification, no critical-edition claim, and no multilingual propagation.
